findings.explanation: a string literal is assigned to `apiKey`: the secret ships in the source instead of coming from the environment
`await` resolves one element at a time over a 3-element literal; the body is independent per element, so the calls could have been composed
`==` compares operands of different apparent kinds (value and string): the comparison coerces one of them
`innerHTML` is assigned a value the document is about to parse as markup
`JSON.parse` of unvalidated input is used without a shape check
